fusions.name: Caught in the Folds
fusions.desc: A slashing arc that deals 4 damage to everything within 2 tiles ahead of you. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pull the Thread
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Torn-Strip Bandage
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilted Gambeson
fusions.desc: Conjures quilted cloth armour: every hit you take deals 2 less damage, and your armour rises by 10%.
